## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger and the observable behavior after this change.

## Test review

For each added or substantially rewritten scenario, state:

- Protected behavior, compatibility, ownership or resource contract.
- Concrete fault it detects; negative control for a coverage guard.
- Existing related coverage and the distinct gap this scenario fills.
- Why content additions or an internal refactor will not break the assertion.
- Execution cost, isolation, label and timeout.

Exact format, mechanics and controlled-fixture assertions may be appropriate;
explain the contract. See [testing guidance](../docs/testing.md).

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results, including warnings, failures,
skips and checks that remain unrun.
